name: Dumbbell Deadlift
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart between two dumbbells resting beside your ankles.
Hinge your hips back and bend your knees with a flat spine to grip both handles.
Brace your core and drive through your feet to stand tall, keeping the dumbbells close to your legs.
Send your hips back and bend your knees under control to lower the dumbbells back down.
tips: Lift your shoulders and hips together as the dumbbells leave the floor.
Keep your back neutral throughout instead of rounding your spine at the bottom.
